item.title: Americans want US to lead globally but doubt military can win major wars
item.description: New Reagan Institute survey reveals Americans want stronger global leadership but question military readiness, with only 49% confident in armed forces.

item.title: AT&T becomes latest corporation to commit to ending DEI programs
item.description: AT&T is joining rivals T-Mobile and Verizon in ending DEI programs to align with the FCC and the Trump Administration.
